desc: Ideation: model as graph, per-component free offset, per-bit majority minimization
**Implement full solution** (I/O parse, CSR build, iterative DFS for `d`/`comp`, vectorized edge consistency check → -1, per-bit per-component majority to set `r`, fast output)

**Review/validation**: verified samples logic, edge cases (M=0, N=1, self-loops with Z=0/Z≠0 via full-edge vectorized check, duplicate/conflicting edges, isolated vertices, ties 2c==s), bits 0..29 sufficient since Z<2^30, complexity O((N+M)+30N) fits limits
**Fallback if too slow/complex**: not needed — CSR + iterative stack traversal is fast enough (~4·10^5 pure-Python steps)
